$description: SYNTHETIC fixture — not a real design. A DTCG plugin export carrying one grey ramp and TWO saturated non-state ramps of 5+ rungs each (indigo, teal), so pickRamps finds more than one brand candidate and REFUSES rather than picking. Exists so the refusal-with-candidates path — the CLI's message, and the swatch affordance the portal drawer and the public drop zone build from err.candidates — is testable with no network, no Figma request spend, and no real design. Hues chosen outside STATE_RAMP (figma-pull's red/green/yellow/orange/amber/lime/success/error/warning/danger/info/destructive/positive/negative/neutral/grey/gray list) or they would be classified as UI states and never counted as candidates.
